title: Evidence Event v2
description: Unified schema for JSONL evidence events produced by release-skill 0.8.0+. The v1 schema (evidence-event.schema.json) was too strict for the real event vocabulary (closed command/status/error enums, additionalProperties:false over phase-specific fields) and is retained only for legacy reads; v1 files are never rewritten. v2 freezes the stable envelope (identity, producer, command, phase, status, error, duration) with additionalProperties closed at the top level: every phase-specific detail field (unitId, gate, hookName, actionId, step, hookId, tagCommit, cached, testSelection, cacheKey, durationMs, exitCode, findingCount, ...) lives inside details. Declared location fields are type-constrained; the remaining details vocabulary stays open and producer-versioned. The evidence writer is the single choke point: it relocates any unknown top-level extension key into details and validates the event against this schema before writing (fail closed).

schemaVersion.description: Event format version (envelope field; never overridable by callers)

runId.description: Unique identifier for the run (directory name)

sequence.description: Real monotonic sequence number assigned by the writer, starting from 1

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event

command.description: The command that triggered this event

status.description: Status value of this event (started/completed/passed/failed/skipped/warning/blocking/... — producer-versioned vocabulary)

name.description: Producer name; attribution only, never an authority

version.description: Producer version; attribution only, never an authority

producer.description: Producer identity for attribution (R-06B). Old v1 runs have no producer field.

error.description: Error details when the event reports a failure. The writer normalizes diagnostic fields before validation (numeric child-process exit codes such as Git 128 are preserved as EXIT_<n>; free string errors become UNKNOWN_ERROR), so the real cause is never replaced by a schema failure.

code.description: Stable error code (open string: error codes are producer-versioned and grow over time)

details.description: Phase-specific supplementary information. Declared location fields are type-constrained; the remaining phase-specific vocabulary stays open.

unitId.description: Release unit the event refers to

gate.description: Safety gate the event refers to

hookName.description: Declared hook the event refers to

actionId.description: External action the event refers to

step.description: Verification or execution step the event refers to

hookId.description: Post-publish hook the event refers to

tagCommit.description: Frozen tag commit the event refers to

cached.description: Whether a hook completion was a cache hit

durationMs.description: Observed duration in milliseconds (null when unobserved)

findingCount.description: Number of findings reported by a gate
